name: Lyndhurst

dates.altered: Nearly doubled for George Merritt in 1864-65, also by Davis, as the node's own exemplar notes state.
dates.note: The Wikipedia infobox prints 'Built 1838' and 'Architect Alexander Jackson Davis'. The HABS data pages carry no construction date: they are a photogrammetric image inventory.
